route.name: Annecy
route.sub: 6 nights — La Madeleine apartment, direct TGV

blocks.title: MIA — check bags & security
blocks.detail:
• Aer Lingus check-in, Terminal E
• Bags tag straight through to Paris — this is the only check-in of the outbound
• Three hours before departure is right for a holiday-week transatlantic

blocks.title: Early dinner at MIA
blocks.detail:
• Eat properly now — the on-board dinner service does not come round until about 8:00–8:45 PM
• Concourse E has a food court; sit-down options are slower and pricier
• Fill water bottles after security
blocks.notes: Airport food court for four, roughly $55–65.

blocks.title: Gate & boarding
blocks.detail:
• Toilets and pyjamas for the kids before boarding
• Anything they need overnight comes out of the bag now

blocks.title: Aer Lingus 140 · MIA → DUB (overnight)
blocks.detail:
• 8h15m, Airbus A330-300, lands Dublin Terminal 2 at 8:20 AM
• FOOD IS INCLUDED: hot dinner with tea/coffee, and since Feb 2025 free wine or beer with the meal
• Dinner arrives about 8:00–8:45 PM — 90 minutes after take-off. That is why you eat at MIA first
• Pre-landing service about 6:50–7:20 AM Dublin time: orange juice, and possibly a hot breakfast sandwich (Aer Lingus lists that sandwich for Chicago/Orlando/SF/LA — NOT Miami, so assume juice only and pack breakfast snacks)
• CHILD MEALS: free, but must be booked BY PHONE — Aer Lingus says they cannot be booked online. Do it at least 48h ahead
• No nut-free meals are offered, deliberately
blocks.program: Aer Lingus award — currency to confirm
blocks.notes: 27,500 points + $29.10 per person. Four passengers = 110,000 points + $116.40. Fare class P, exactly 4 seats showing. Total elapsed MIA→CDG is 11h40m.
blocks.flag: Only 4 award seats — no margin. Confirm the points currency before assuming the balance covers it.

blocks.title: Dublin connection — 1h35m
blocks.detail:
• Both flights are Aer Lingus, both Terminal 2
• Follow 'Flight Connections' to passport control
• Bags move automatically on the single ticket; no second security screening
• Buy coffee and something for the kids here — nothing is available on arrival at CDG before immigration
blocks.flag: Under the 1h45m–2h Aer Lingus recommends for US arrivals continuing into Europe. A late EI140 threatens the Paris leg.

blocks.title: Aer Lingus 524 · DUB → CDG
blocks.detail:
• 1h50m, Airbus A320, arrives Paris CDG Terminal 1
• BUY-ON-BOARD ONLY — nothing is free on Aer Lingus short-haul, not even water
• Bia menu: sandwiches/wraps €6, hot Irish breakfast €11, porridge €3.50, muffin €3, tea/coffee €3, soft drinks €3. No children's menu
• Four people buying onboard is about €36, and on a 1h50m sector the trolley may not reach every row
• DO THIS INSTEAD: buy food airside at Dublin T2 during the connection — Phoenix Lane Express, Dubh & Dubh, Cloud Picker and Starbucks all open from 04:00
• Buy drinks AFTER security

blocks.title: CDG Terminal 1 — passport control & bags
blocks.detail:
• Ireland is outside Schengen, so this is a full external-border arrival
• EU Entry/Exit System: passport scan, photo and fingerprints for the adults
• Children under 12 are exempt from fingerprinting — photo and scan only
• Baggage claim is Level 5
• Keep snacks in hand luggage: the queue is where the kids will crack, not after
blocks.flag: T1 queues of 60–90 minutes have been reported at peak since EES rolled out, and 13:00–18:00 is a peak band. Budget up to 2 hours wheels-down to arrivals hall.

blocks.title: Lunch at CDG — McDonald's, public area
blocks.detail:
• Landside McDonald's, Terminal 1 public zone (CDGVAL level) — follow signs down from arrivals
• Open 06:00–22:00, 450 m², table service, ordering kiosks and a children's play area
• The only hot food at T1 with real seating and somewhere for the kids to burn off the flight
• Cheaper alternative if everyone is flagging: Marks & Spencer Food on the arrivals level (Level 5, 06:30–20:30) — sandwiches and fruit, grab-and-go, no detour
blocks.notes: About €40–45 for four. A Big Mac menu at CDG runs about €12.90 against €8.90 in town — airport markup is roughly 45%. M&S picnic instead would be about €30–35.

blocks.title: Back up to arrivals — taxi rank
blocks.detail:
• Official rank is Level 5 (arrivals), Exit 24, past the car-rental desks
• Use the marked rank only — ignore anyone offering a ride in the hall
• Uber/VTC pickup is a different place (Departures, Exit 16)

blocks.title: Taxi CDG → Hyatt Regency Paris Étoile
blocks.detail:
• Regulated flat rate: €56 Right Bank (Porte Maillot is the 17th)
• Covers up to 4 passengers, luggage included, no surcharges
• 30 km, 45–60 minutes
• Ask for a van (monospace) at the rank so all four fit in one car
blocks.notes: €56 flat rate. Beats RER B (€14/adult, €7/child = €42) once you add two changes and stairs with suitcases. Roissybus was permanently discontinued 28 Feb 2026.
blocks.flag: RER B is running reduced frequency through 2026 engineering works — another reason to take the taxi.

blocks.title: Check in — Hyatt Regency Paris Étoile, 4 nights, 2 rooms
blocks.detail:
• 3 Place du Général Kœnig, 75017 Paris
• Métro 1, RER C and RER E all run directly underneath
• Ask about Regency Club access for BOTH rooms — breakfast is the whole budget plan
• Request high floor, south-facing, connecting rooms
blocks.roomType: 2 rooms — high floor, Eiffel Tower view requested
blocks.notes: 15,000 points per room per night × 2 rooms × 4 nights = 120,000. Category 4: 12,000 off-peak / 15,000 standard / 18,000 peak. The $78 is PARIS TOURIST TAX — €8.45 per adult per night at 4-star, 2 adults × 4 nights ≈ €68, payable at checkout even on an award booking. Under-18s are exempt.
blocks.flag: Confirm these dates don't price at Category 4 peak (18,000/night = 144,000 total), and that Regency Club breakfast covers the second room. Breakfast in the Mayo restaurant is €25 per person — €100 a morning if the lounge doesn't cover you.

blocks.title: Unpack & reset
blocks.detail:
• Everyone has been travelling about 22 hours
• Showers, unpack, no agenda
• Do not let the kids sleep now — push through to a normal bedtime

blocks.title: Short walk — Palais des Congrès & Christmas lights
blocks.detail:
• Straight out the hotel door, flat and lit
• Twenty minutes of fresh air is what resets a body clock
• Dinner is booked at Da Aldo, 8 minutes the other way — no shopping needed tonight

blocks.title: Dinner — Da Aldo
blocks.detail:
• 8 rue Saint-Ferdinand, 75017 · 8–10 min walk via avenue de la Grande Armée
• Italian. Pizzas €13–18 (Margherita €13, Parma €15), pasta €12.50–20
• No children's menu, but a pizza splits easily between the two kids
• Dinner from 19:00. Closed Sunday. Reserve: 01 45 72 15 04
blocks.notes: About €60–75 for four. Le Congrès Maillot next door is the obvious walk-out option but is a seafood brasserie — verified at €95–115 for four.
blocks.flag: Léon Porte Maillot, the usual family fallback nearby, appears to be permanently closed — do not plan on it.

blocks.title: Early night
blocks.detail:
• Six hours ahead of Miami — the first night is the one that fixes the jet lag
• Lights out for the kids by 8:45

days.title: Tuileries Christmas market & the Champs-Élysées lights

blocks.title: Breakfast — Regency Club, 34th floor
blocks.detail:
• Included with the stay — this is the single biggest saving of the Paris leg
• Buffet breakfast with Eiffel Tower views
• Eat properly; lunch is not until about 12:45
blocks.notes: €0 if Regency Club access covers the family. The paid alternative is €25 per person in Mayo — €100 a morning.

blocks.title: Bois de Boulogne — morning walk
blocks.detail:
• Directly across from the hotel, no transport needed
• Flat paths, lakes, ducks; free
• Deliberately gentle — first full day after a transatlantic

blocks.title: Métro 1 · Porte Maillot → Concorde
blocks.detail:
• Line 1 from beneath the hotel, direction Château de Vincennes
• 6 stops, about 11 minutes, NO changes
• Line 1 is automated with platform screen doors — the easiest line in Paris with small children
• Buy Navigo Easy cards at the Porte Maillot window this morning (see the Ideas tab)
blocks.notes: Family fare is €7.70 a leg (2 adults × €2.55 + 2 children × €1.30). Three legs today = €23.10, plus the four Navigo Easy cards at €2 each, bought once.

blocks.title: Tuileries Christmas Market — La Magie de Noël
blocks.detail:
• Jardin des Tuileries, north side, 1st arr. — exit Concorde and it is right there
• FREE entry. About 100 chalets, carousel, toddler train, bumper cars, fun houses
• Open from 11:00
• Getting back: Métro 1 from Concorde or Tuileries, direct to Porte Maillot
blocks.flag: 2026–27 dates are not yet published. The 2025–26 edition ran 15 Nov – 4 Jan, so your dates almost certainly fall inside — re-check in November. Guaranteed fallback: La Défense market, confirmed 12 Nov – 31 Dec 2026, four stops on Métro 1.

blocks.title: Lunch — market chalets, Tuileries
blocks.detail:
• Eat at the market: crêpes, hot dogs, tartiflette, churros, hot chocolate
• Warm, quick, no reservation, and the kids choose their own
• Cheaper still: buy baguette sandwiches at a bakery near the hotel before leaving and eat them in the gardens
blocks.notes: Market food for four, roughly €30–38. Crêpe €5–7, vin chaud €5–6, hot dog €7–9, churros €5 — estimates, no market publishes a tariff.

blocks.title: Tuileries rides & carousel
blocks.detail:
• Pick TWO things, not all of them — the rides add up fast
• Carousel and small rides about €3–5 per child per go
• Ice rink is €10 adult / €6 child = €32 for four if you want a bigger one
• Skip the Ferris wheel — €15 a head with no child rate
blocks.notes: Budget €20 for a few goes on the carousel and rides. Ride prices are estimates — nothing is published.

blocks.title: Walk — Tuileries → Concorde → Champs-Élysées
blocks.detail:
• Out the west end of the gardens, across Place de la Concorde
• Then up the Champs-Élysées as far as the kids want — it is 1.9 km end to end, you do not need to walk it all
• Dark by about 5:00 PM

blocks.title: Champs-Élysées Christmas illuminations
blocks.detail:
• Lights switch on at 17:00 and run to midnight (1:00 AM Fri and Sat)
• Free. The trees down both sides of the avenue are the whole point
• Then walk to Franklin D. Roosevelt métro for dinner

blocks.title: Métro to dinner
blocks.detail:
• Walk to Franklin D. Roosevelt station, on the Champs-Élysées itself
• Take MÉTRO 9 direction Mairie de Montreuil → Grands Boulevards. Direct, no change, about 12 minutes
• Line 9 runs through Franklin D. Roosevelt, so you board there rather than doubling back

blocks.title: Dinner — Bouillon Chartier, Grands Boulevards
blocks.detail:
• 7 rue du Faubourg Montmartre, 75009 · Métro Grands Boulevards
• Historic 1896 dining hall, open daily 11:30–00:00, NO reservations — go early to beat the queue
• Mains from €7: roast chicken €10.50, confit de canard €12.50, steak with pepper sauce €13.20
• Starters from €1, desserts from €2, green beans €2.60
• No formal children's menu, but roast chicken and plain sides work perfectly
• This is the cheapest genuinely memorable meal in Paris
blocks.notes: About €70–80 for four including drinks. A comparable meal in a Rue Cler bistro would be €130–140.

blocks.title: Métro back to the hotel
blocks.detail:
• Métro 9 → Franklin D. Roosevelt, change to Métro 1 → Porte Maillot
• About 25 minutes

days.title: Eiffel Tower, Trocadéro & a Seine cruise

blocks.title: Breakfast — Regency Club
blocks.detail:
• Included
• Today is the biggest walking day — eat well
• Grab fruit for pockets on the way out

blocks.title: RER C · Neuilly–Porte Maillot → Champ de Mars–Tour Eiffel
blocks.detail:
• RER C runs directly beneath the hotel — this is the hidden advantage of Porte Maillot
• DIRECT, 4 stops, 11–12 minutes, no changes and no stair interchange
• Trains about every 15 minutes
• Same €2.55 / €1.30 fare as one métro stop
blocks.notes: Three legs today at €7.70 a leg — out, across to dinner, and home.

blocks.title: Champ de Mars & the Eiffel Tower from below
blocks.detail:
• The tower straight up from the lawns — free, and the view children actually remember
• Carousel at the base
• NOT going up: €59 for four to the 2nd floor, cold, queued, and dark by 16:00. Trocadéro next is the better picture and costs nothing

blocks.title: Pont d'Iéna → Trocadéro
blocks.detail:
• Cross the bridge and climb to Place du Trocadéro — the classic Eiffel photograph
• Quai Branly Christmas market sits along the river on the way
• Flat, about 15 minutes at child pace

blocks.title: Lunch — Quai Branly Christmas market
blocks.detail:
• Market chalets along the river: crêpes, sausages, tartiflette, hot chocolate
• Warm and quick, and it avoids the 7th arrondissement restaurant trap
• DO NOT eat sit-down near the tower: the cheapest Rue Cler plat du jour is €16–17 a head, so €65+ before drinks
blocks.notes: Roughly €35–42 for four. Market dates for 2026 unconfirmed — if it is not running, the bakery-picnic fallback is to buy near the hotel before boarding the RER.
blocks.flag: Quai Branly market 2026 dates unpublished. Carry a bakery lunch as backup.

blocks.title: Walk Trocadéro → Pont de l'Alma
blocks.detail:
• Down the hill along avenue du Président Wilson, about 15 minutes
• Time in hand before the boat — there is a warm café at the embarkation point

blocks.title: Seine cruise — Bateaux Mouches
blocks.detail:
• Departs Port de la Conférence, Pont de l'Alma, 8th arr.
• 1 hour, heated glass-roofed boat, seated — the warmest hour of the day
• BOOK ONLINE: €17 adult / €8 child (under 13) = €50 for four. At the pier it is €20/€10 = €60
• Under 4 free
• Timed so you leave in daylight and come back as the lights come on
blocks.notes: €50 booked online. Vedettes du Pont Neuf is €44 but departs from Île de la Cité, which does not fit this day.

blocks.title: Warm up — hot chocolate
blocks.detail:
• Café near the quay before the métro
• Everyone will be cold off the water

blocks.title: Métro straight to dinner
blocks.detail:
• Do NOT go back to the hotel first — dinner is in the 10th and the hotel is the wrong direction
• Métro 9 from Alma–Marceau → Strasbourg–Saint-Denis. DIRECT, no change, about 20 minutes
• Bouillon Julien is 100 m from that exit

blocks.title: Dinner — Bouillon Julien
blocks.detail:
• 16 rue du Faubourg Saint-Denis, 75010 · Métro Strasbourg–Saint-Denis, 100 m
• Straight from the boat on Métro 9 — you do not return to the hotel in between
• Spectacular 1906 Art Nouveau room — the kids will remember it
• Starters €3.50–9.90, mains €10.90–14.50, desserts €3.50–6.90, service included
• TAKES RESERVATIONS, unlike Chartier — book it: +33 1 47 70 12 06
• Open daily 11:45–00:00
blocks.notes: About €70–80 for four. Book the table for 18:15.

blocks.title: Métro back to the hotel
blocks.detail:
• Strasbourg–Saint-Denis is 2 minutes from the door
• Métro 9, direction Pont de Sèvres → Franklin D. Roosevelt (7 stops)
• Change to Métro 1, direction La Défense → Porte Maillot (4 stops)
• About 30 minutes; last trains run well past midnight

blocks.title: Breakfast — Regency Club
blocks.detail:
• Included
• Last Paris breakfast before the train day

blocks.title: Métro · Porte Maillot → Anvers
blocks.detail:
• Métro 1 → Charles de Gaulle–Étoile (1 stop, 2 min)
• Change to Métro 2, direction Nation → Anvers (8 stops, ~14 min)
• About 22 minutes total, one change
• Exit Anvers and walk up rue de Steinkerque towards the basilica
blocks.notes: Two legs today at €7.70 — out and back. The funicular is ticketed separately.

blocks.title: Montmartre funicular
blocks.detail:
• Saves about 200 steps with a 5-year-old — worth every cent
• Takes a standard Métro ticket: €2.55 adult, €1.30 child = €7.70 for four, one way
• Note: the ticket does NOT let you transfer to another mode afterwards

blocks.title: Sacré-Cœur & the terrace
blocks.detail:
• Entry to the basilica is completely FREE, open 06:30–22:30 daily
• The terrace in front is one of the great free views in Paris — the whole city laid out
• Carousel at the foot of the hill
• Skipping the dome climb: €26 for four and 280 steps with no lift, not realistic with a 5-year-old

blocks.title: Lunch — Bouillon Pigalle
blocks.detail:
• 22 boulevard de Clichy, 75018 · about 10 minutes downhill from Sacré-Cœur
• Open 7 days, 12:00–00:00 — one of the few reliable Sunday options
• Œuf mayonnaise €2.50, onion soup €3.90, sausage & mash €9.60, bœuf bourguignon €12.20, steak-frites €12.60, duck confit €12.80
• Fries €3.00, rice pudding €2.80, crème brûlée €3.80, soft drinks €1.10–2.60
• No kids' menu, but sausage-and-mash at €9.60 is the children's dish
• No reservations — arrive at 12:00 to avoid the queue
blocks.notes: About €60–68 for four. Menu prices from the official card; a 2026 guide confirms mains still €9.80–12.20, so add ~10% margin.

blocks.title: Place du Tertre & the Montmartre back streets
blocks.detail:
• Street artists on the square, then the quieter lanes behind — rue de l'Abreuvoir, the vineyard, the Wall of Love
• Abbesses Christmas market at Place des Abbesses if running
• All free; this is a wander, not a schedule

blocks.title: Crêpe stop
blocks.detail:
• Street crêpe stands all over Montmartre — €4–6 each
• Bridges the gap to a light supper

blocks.title: Métro back to the hotel
blocks.detail:
• Walk down to Anvers or Pigalle
• Métro 2 → Charles de Gaulle–Étoile, change to Métro 1 → Porte Maillot
• About 25 minutes

blocks.title: Dinner — Il Grano
blocks.detail:
• 212 bis boulevard Pereire, 75017 · 10–15 min walk from the hotel
• OPEN SUNDAY 11:30–22:30 — confirmed, which rules out most of the 17th tonight
• Pinsa romana and pizza €13.50–19.50, pasta €18–23, desserts €7.50–11
• Light and fast, which is what you want before a travel day. Reserve: 01 58 57 99 46
blocks.notes: About €70–85 for four.
blocks.flag: Closed Sunday nearby, so do not default to them: Da Aldo, Le Paris 17, Crêperie L'Étoile d'Or, Crêperie du Palais.

blocks.title: Repack for Annecy
blocks.detail:
• Winter gear and snow clothes to the top of the bags
• No passports needed tomorrow — the whole week stays in France

blocks.title: Lights out
blocks.detail:
• Tomorrow is one direct train — taxi at 8:30, in Annecy by 13:30
• Working back from a 7:15 breakfast: bedtime now

blocks.title: Breakfast — Regency Club
blocks.detail:
• Included. Eat a real breakfast — lunch is not until about 13:45 in Annecy
• Fill water bottles
• Take a couple of pastries for the train

blocks.title: Checkout
blocks.detail:
• Bags down, checkout, hold nothing back
• Confirm the taxi at the door

blocks.title: Taxi · hotel → Gare de Lyon
blocks.detail:
• Métro 1 goes there direct in ~25 minutes, but with four people and winter luggage in Monday rush hour the taxi is the right call
• About €25–30, metered — this is an intra-Paris trip, not an airport forfait
• Missing this train costs the day — do not economise here

blocks.title: Gare de Lyon — snacks for the train
blocks.detail:
• TGV INOUI to Annecy: check the departure board for the hall — Halls 1 and 2 are side by side
• Monop'Daily (Hall 2, level 0) or Paul for pastries, fruit and drinks — this is the mid-morning snack, not lunch
• Platform posts about 20 minutes before departure

blocks.title: TGV INOUI · Paris Gare de Lyon → Annecy
blocks.detail:
• DIRECT, 3h43, no changes — published timetable for Monday 21 December (also 06:45→10:38 and 12:46→16:34)
• Domestic TGV, so the Carte Avantage price cap applies: adults never pay more than €89
• Bar car for hot drinks; reserved seats — book four together
• Annecy station exit → the apartment is a four-minute walk
blocks.notes: Budgeted at $215 for four with the Carte Avantage. Floor is about $150 at opening-day advance fares; ceiling about $270 at the cap. Sales for these dates open on 30 September — book that morning.
blocks.flag: No border, no bus, no Geneva. Compare the Chamonix version of this day: Lyria to Geneva, a walk to the coach, 1h26 up the valley, and a 15:50 arrival. This one is in the apartment by 13:45.

blocks.title: Walk to the apartment — La Madeleine
blocks.detail:
• 7 rue de l'Annexion — 1,200 ft from the station, four minutes with bags, flat
• Drop bags even if the apartment is not ready — confirm the check-in time with the host when you book

blocks.title: Check in — La Madeleine apartment, 6 nights
blocks.detail:
• 7 rue de l'Annexion, 74000 Annecy — between the station (4 min) and the old town (Palais de l'Isle 5 min)
• Whole apartment, 431 ft²: 1 bedroom with a double, sofa bed in the living room, FULL KITCHEN with dishwasher, washing machine, balcony
• Elevator in the building; Booking 7.9/10 from 162 reviews
• The two day-trip buses (Y62 to Le Grand-Bornand, BlaBlaCar to Chamonix) and the Semnoz bus all leave from beside the station — four minutes away
blocks.notes: Booking quote $859 for six nights on the free-cancellation rate (cancel until 16 December), EXCLUDING 10% VAT and a 5% 'city tax' line — budgeted at $990 all in. The non-refundable rate is $773. Real Annecy taxe de séjour is about €1–2 per adult per night; the 5% looks like a platform fee.
blocks.flag: Against the Cham sud apartment at $1,370, this saves about $380. Cheaper still: Séjours & Affaires Le Pont Neuf, an aparthotel in Cran-Gevrier at about $700 all in — but 15 minutes from the station and 20 from the old town, which you would walk twice a day. See the Ideas tab.

blocks.title: Lunch — Les Burgers de Papa
blocks.detail:
• 11 rue Président Favre — two minutes from the apartment, on the way into town
• Fast, warm, no booking: burger menus from €9.90, the 'Bons Plans de Tonton' combo €14.50
• Deliberately simple after a travel morning — the proper Annecy meals start tonight
blocks.notes: About €40–45 for four. No published children's menu, but a plain burger and fries splits easily.

blocks.title: Old town on foot — canals, Palais de l'Isle, Pont des Amours
blocks.detail:
• Rue Sainte-Claire under the arcades, the Thiou canal, the Palais de l'Isle from the bridge — the postcard
• Out to the Jardins de l'Europe and across the Pont des Amours to Le Pâquier: swans, ducks, the lake with the mountains behind
• Dark by about 16:50 — this is your daylight look; the market is better after dark anyway
• All free, all flat, all within ten minutes of the apartment

blocks.title: Carrefour City shop — the week's breakfasts
blocks.detail:
• 14 avenue de Chambéry — three minutes from the apartment, by the station. Mon–Sat 07:00–20:50, Sunday 09:00–12:50
• Buy: bread, croissants, butter, jam, cereal, milk, coffee, juice, fruit, yoghurts, cheese, ham, crisps, chocolate, water
• Six breakfasts in a real kitchen for about €100, against €50+ a morning in a café
• Monoprix (65 rue Carnot) is the bigger shop if you need it — closed Sundays
blocks.notes: One adult can do this alone while the other gets the kids settled — it is three minutes away.

blocks.title: Noël des Alpes — the market after dark
blocks.detail:
• 135+ artisan chalets from Quai de Vicenza through Place Saint-Maurice to the Jardins de l'Europe, plus Santa at Place de l'Ancienne Grenette
• FREE entry. Illuminations on the old town, vin chaud for the adults, chocolat chaud for the kids
• Natural outdoor ICE RINK (about 450 m²) in the Jardins de l'Europe — you skate here on the 23rd
• 2025–26 edition ran 29 Nov – 4 Jan, 11:00–21:00 (21:30 Fri/Sat and holidays)
blocks.flag: 2026–27 dates are not yet published — the city posts them in October/November. Every recent edition has covered your dates.

blocks.title: Dinner — Brasserie des Européens
blocks.detail:
• Esplanade de l'Hôtel de Ville — five minutes from the apartment, beside the Pâquier
• Open every day for lunch and dinner, which is why it is Monday's pick: several old-town kitchens close Mon–Tue
• Classic brasserie — steak-frites, fish, salads, a dessert trolley the kids will remember
• Reserve: 04 50 45 00 81
blocks.notes: About €70–80 for four. No published children's menu — ask; brasseries of this kind almost always do a plat enfant around €10–12.

days.title: Le Semnoz — sledging above the lake

blocks.title: Breakfast in the apartment
blocks.detail:
• From last night's Carrefour shop, in a real kitchen
• Adults: coffee is enough if you prefer
• Snow gear on before you leave — there is nowhere warm to change at the bus stop

blocks.title: Walk to the Semnoz bus — Annecy Gare
blocks.detail:
• The S2 leaves from the stops beside the station, four minutes from the door
• Ten minutes of slack is enough — this is a city bus, not a coach
• Sledges: hire at the top (see below), do not carry anything up

blocks.title: Bus S2 · Annecy Gare → Semnoz Alpin
blocks.detail:
• Grand Annecy 'Mobil'hiver' winter line — about 60 minutes up the mountain road, calling Pont Neuf, Église des Bressis and Marché on the way
• Runs DAILY through the school holidays (20 Dec – 4 Jan pattern), weekends only otherwise
• Standard SIBRA city fare, about €2 a ride (€2.50 if bought on board) — the cheapest snow of the whole trip
• Return buses from Semnoz Alpin: 14:25, 15:45, 16:45, 17:45, 18:15
blocks.notes: 2025–26 timetable: Annecy Gare departures 07:30, 08:30, 09:30, 10:30, 12:00, 13:15. Child single fare not published — budget €2 each. Taxi is the fallback: about 25 minutes, roughly €35–55 each way, metered.
blocks.flag: The 2026–27 sheet publishes in November. A 'reduced' service on 24 December is confirmed for 2025; assume the same and check the December sheet before you go.

blocks.title: Semnoz — the sledging slopes
blocks.detail:
• 1,700 m at the top, open ground above the tree line, the whole lake and the Aravis laid out below
• FREE toboggan piste with safety nets and TWO FREE CONVEYOR LIFTS (tapis) — no walking back up, which is the difference between an hour and an afternoon with a 5-year-old
• Sledge hire at the Nordic Forest chalet: €5 for a half-day (09:00–13:00), €8 all day. No booking
• SNOW TUBING: a 60 m track beside the sledging area, from age 3, sold on a points card (1 point = 2 runs, cards from about €4)
• Open 09:00–17:00 when the station is open
blocks.notes: Three sledges at €5 plus a tubing card — about €45. This whole day costs less than one lift pass in Chamonix.
blocks.flag: SNOW: Semnoz has closed entirely in low-snow Decembers. Check semnoz.fr's live status ('Ouverte / Fermée') the night before. If it is shut, swap in the Le Grand-Bornand day (higher, better cover) and do Annecy on the 24th instead.

blocks.title: Lunch — Le 1407, Semnoz Alpin
blocks.detail:
• The snack-restaurant at the top station (the old 'Chez JP'), at the foot of the Bauges-side slopes
• Daily-changing Savoyard plates, croque-monsieur, chips, hot chocolate — warm room, big windows
• Alternative with a published children's menu: Le Châtillon, lower on the Viuz side — menu enfant €10, tartiflette €18.50
blocks.notes: About €45–50 for four. No prices published for Le 1407 — mountain-snack pricing, expect €12–16 a plate.

blocks.title: Second run — snow play until the bus
blocks.detail:
• Back on the sledges, or just snowmen and snowball fights on the open ground
• Stop at 15:30 sharp: the 15:45 bus is the one that gets you home for dinner without a rush
• Hot chocolate at Le 1407 while you wait if anyone is cold

blocks.title: Bus S2 · Semnoz Alpin → Annecy Gare
blocks.detail:
• Down the mountain, about an hour
• Everyone will sleep
• Four minutes home from the station

blocks.title: Back at the apartment — dry everything out
blocks.detail:
• Wet gear over the radiators, boots opened out, socks straight into the washing machine — the apartment has one
• Hot showers and a quiet hour before dinner

blocks.title: Dinner — Le Fréti
blocks.detail:
• 12 rue Sainte-Claire, in the arcades of the old town — six minutes on foot
• THE Savoyard place: fondue and raclette for the adults after a day in the snow
• Plat du jour €11–15; full fondue menus €25 and up per adult; MENU ENFANT €12.50
• Reserve: 04 50 51 29 52 — it fills every winter evening
blocks.notes: About €80 for four with one shared fondue and two children's menus. This is one of the two 'nice' dinners of the Annecy week.
blocks.flag: Weekly closure day not published — confirm when you book, and ask about 24 December while you are on the phone.

days.title: Annecy — château, lake & the market rink

blocks.title: Breakfast in the apartment
blocks.detail:
• No bus today, no early start — the recovery day between two snow days
• Everything today is within ten minutes on foot

blocks.title: Château d'Annecy
blocks.detail:
• Up the hill from the old town — ten minutes, steepish, the view over the roofs is the reward
• Winter hours 10:00–12:30 and 14:00–17:30. CLOSED TUESDAYS and 24–25 December — which is why it is today
• €6.50 adult, UNDER-12s FREE — €13 for the family
• Lake archaeology, medieval rooms, the ramparts: an hour to ninety minutes with a 5- and 7-year-old, not more
• The tourist office runs a family trail, 'Le château à petits pas' — ask at the desk

blocks.title: Lunch — La Bolée crêperie
blocks.detail:
• 41 rue Carnot, old town, since 1979 — four minutes down from the château
• Savoury galettes for lunch, sweet crêpes after; the kind of menu a 5-year-old can order from
• Open Tue–Sat 11:45–22:30. Closed Sunday and Monday
blocks.notes: About €45–50 for four. Prices not published online — crêperie pricing, galettes €9–14.

blocks.title: Le Pâquier & the lakefront
blocks.detail:
• Across the Pont des Amours to the big lakeside meadow — swans, ducks, room to run
• Bring seed, not bread
• Flat, pushchair-friendly, mountains across the water. Free
• Cold: this is the coldest part of the day by the water. Gloves, and keep moving

blocks.title: Ice skating — the market rink, Jardins de l'Europe
blocks.detail:
• The Noël des Alpes natural outdoor rink, about 450 m², right in the gardens — no bus, no changing rooms in a sports hall
• Small enough that the 5-year-old can hold the rail the whole way round
• Skate hire on site
blocks.notes: Price not published — market rinks of this size run €5–8 with skates. Budgeted at €25 for four.
blocks.flag: Indoor alternative: Patinoire Jean Régis, 90 chemin des Fins, 04 50 57 56 02 — Olympic-size, a 'Jardin de Glace' beginners' zone, UNDER-5s FREE, about €8.40 adult with skates. Regular Wednesday session 14:00–17:00; holiday hours not yet published. It is 2 km north — a short bus or a €10 taxi.

blocks.title: Goûter — crêpes & chocolat chaud
blocks.detail:
• A market chalet or any café on Place Saint-Maurice
• A real snack, not just a drink: lunch was at noon and dinner is at seven
• Timed so the market lights come on while you are sitting down

blocks.title: Noël des Alpes — chalets and Santa
blocks.detail:
• Dusk at 16:50 — the market at its best
• Santa's chalet at Place de l'Ancienne Grenette; the artisan chalets along Quai de Vicenza and rue du Collège-Chappuisien
• This is the evening to buy the small things — tomorrow is Christmas Eve and the chalets close early (about 19:00)

blocks.title: Dinner — Le Napoli
blocks.detail:
• 8 rue du Pâquier — three minutes from the apartment
• Pizza and pasta, about twenty pizzas, lasagne, veal; states an 'adapted children's menu'
• Open daily except Sunday in winter
• Reserve: 04 50 51 76 06
blocks.notes: About €55–60 for four. Children's menu price not published — ask when booking.

days.title: Le Grand-Bornand — village sledging & tubing, then Christmas Eve

blocks.title: Breakfast in the apartment
blocks.detail:
• The one early start of the week — it buys a whole day in a real alpine village
• Pack snacks and water; the café stops are further apart than in Annecy
• Snow gear on, spare gloves and socks in the bag

blocks.title: Walk to the gare routière
blocks.detail:
• The coach station is 50 m to the right as you leave the railway station — four minutes from the apartment
• Ticket office is 10 m from the station exit; or buy on the bus (CASH, exact change), or online at Altibus

blocks.title: Bus Y62 · Annecy → Le Grand-Bornand village
blocks.detail:
• ARVI Mobilité lines Y62/Y63, about 1h10 via Thônes and Saint-Jean-de-Sixt
• School-holiday weekday departures cluster at 08:00, 08:25, 08:55, 09:25 — take the one closest to 08:30 on the December sheet
• €8.60 single / €16 return per adult; children's fare not published — budget €50 for four
• Get off at Le Grand-Bornand VILLAGE (not Chinaillon): the sledging areas and the Rosay gondola are here
blocks.notes: Same bus goes on to La Clusaz if you would rather swap villages. Le Grand-Bornand is the more family-built of the two — the 'Famille Plus' label, and sledging IN the village.
blocks.flag: Christmas Eve runs on a holiday timetable — confirm the return departures on the December sheet before you set out. Aim to be on a bus by 15:30.

blocks.title: La Grenouille — village sledging
blocks.detail:
• 'La Grenouille au Borne': a sunny, gently sloping sledging area in the heart of the village, built for the little ones. FREE, open daily in season, helmets advised
• No lift, no ticket, no queue — the 5-year-old's slope
• Second free area, L'Abeille at Venay, if this one is busy
• Sledge hire from the village sports shops — about €5–10 for the day

blocks.title: Rosay gondola → snow tubing & La Marmotte
blocks.detail:
• PEDESTRIAN ticket on the Rosay gondola: €7.70 return per person aged 5–74, UNDER-5s FREE — €23.10 for the four of you
• At the top: the SNOW-TUBING TRACK (from age 3; two tube sizes, split at 120 cm) and 'La Marmotte', a 2,600 m² sledging area inside the beginners' zone
• Deep, reliable snow at 1,300 m+ — this is the day that guarantees the kids see proper winter whatever Annecy looks like
• Views back down the Aravis
blocks.notes: Gondola €23.10 plus tubing. Tubing price per session is NOT published — budget €30 for the kids and confirm at the ticket office.
blocks.flag: Confirm the tubing track is open on 24 December — it is listed as seasonal but not date-by-date.

blocks.title: Lunch — Pizzeria Casanova, Le Grand-Bornand
blocks.detail:
• In the village, a few minutes from the gondola base
• MENU ENFANT €10 (tartiflette + lollipop + ice cream), burgers €12, pâtes bornandine €13, pizzas to €15
• Warm, fast, no fuss — exactly right after three hours in the snow
blocks.notes: About €50 for four.

blocks.title: The village — church square, Christmas lights, a last slide
blocks.detail:
• Le Grand-Bornand is a working Savoyard village, not a purpose-built resort: the baroque church, wooden chalets, reblochon shops
• Christmas Eve afternoon is quiet and pretty. One last run at La Grenouille if there is energy
• Bus stop is in the village centre — be there ten minutes early

blocks.title: Bus Y62 · Le Grand-Bornand → Annecy
blocks.detail:
• Return leg of the same ticket
• Back at the gare routière about 16:40, four minutes from the apartment

blocks.title: Market stop — crêpes on the way home
blocks.detail:
• Five minutes from the coach station into the market; the chalets close early on the 24th (about 19:00)
• Bridges the gap to a 19:15 festive dinner — nobody should arrive at a five-course menu starving

blocks.title: Back at the apartment — dry out, dress up
blocks.detail:
• Wet gear on the radiators, everyone through the shower, then into something decent for Christmas Eve
• Presents organised for the morning

blocks.title: Christmas Eve dinner
blocks.detail:
• One of the two proper meals of the trip — worth the money
• Annecy restaurants run FIXED festive menus on the 24th and they sell out. Book in November, when annecy-ville.fr publishes the year's list
• Confirmed to open 24 Dec in recent years, with prices: Ô Bon Bec (€110 adult, €45 child 5–11 — the one with a real children's price), Le Clocher in Annecy-le-Vieux (€68, five courses), Brasserie Bocuse Irma on the lake (€82/€86)
• Cheaper route: Le Fréti or Le Ramoneur Savoyard if either serves a normal card on the 24th — ask when you book Tuesday's table
blocks.notes: Budgeted at €215 for four — two adult festive menus at about €80 plus two children at about €25–45. Ô Bon Bec at €310 is the ceiling.
blocks.flag: A five-course menu starting at 19:30 ends after 21:30. Book the EARLIEST sitting offered, and ask whether the children's menu can be served fast.

days.title: Christmas Day — presents, snow, the lake

blocks.title: Breakfast & presents in the apartment
blocks.detail:
• No fixed start
• Assume every shop is shut — you shopped on the 21st and topped up on the 23rd
• The one thing that reliably runs on Christmas Day is the mountain: lifts, snow and the Semnoz bus (public-holiday timetable)

blocks.title: Walk to the Semnoz bus
blocks.detail:
• Four minutes to the stops beside the station
• Check the holiday timetable the night before — the 10:30 is the target

blocks.title: Bus S2 · Annecy Gare → Semnoz Alpin
blocks.detail:
• The Mobil'hiver line runs on public holidays — Christmas Day included on the published pattern
• About €2 a head; an hour up
blocks.flag: The 2025 sheet confirms a REDUCED service on 24 December; 25 December is not called out separately. If the December 2026 sheet shows no 10:30, take the 09:30, or a taxi (about €35–55, 25 minutes).

blocks.title: Christmas morning on the sledges
blocks.detail:
• Same free netted piste and conveyor lifts as the 22nd — sledge hire €5 half-day
• Christmas Day is the quietest day of the week up here
• Snow at 1,700 m in the sun with the lake below is the memory of this trip

blocks.title: Christmas lunch — Le 1407 or Le Châtillon
blocks.detail:
• Le 1407 at the top station, or Le Châtillon (menu enfant €10, tartiflette €18.50, fondue €27.50) — call both in mid-December to see which is serving on the 25th
• A hot Savoyard lunch on the mountain IS the Christmas meal today; the evening is kept light
blocks.notes: About €75–80 for four.
blocks.flag: If neither mountain restaurant opens on the 25th, carry the lunch up from the 23rd's shop and move the Christmas meal to the evening (see the dinner block).

blocks.title: Bus S2 · Semnoz Alpin → Annecy Gare
blocks.detail: • The 14:25, home by 15:30 with daylight left for the lake

blocks.title: Pont des Amours at dusk
blocks.detail:
• Out to the bridge and along the Jardins de l'Europe as the light goes — the market lights come on about 16:50
• Free, ten minutes from the door

blocks.title: Back at the apartment — Christmas afternoon
blocks.detail:
• Presents, warmth, nothing planned
• Kitchen means hot chocolate on tap

blocks.title: Christmas dinner — Le Ramoneur Savoyard
blocks.detail:
• 7 rue Grenette, old town — six minutes on foot
• Savoyard set menus €21–33.50 per adult; MENU ENFANT 'P'tits Malins' €12.90
• Reserve: 04 50 51 29 03 — and ask specifically whether they open on the evening of the 25th; some of their set menus are excluded on public holidays
blocks.notes: About €90 for four. Fallback if closed: Brasserie des Européens (open every day per its site, 04 50 45 00 81) or Brasserie Saint Maurice (continuous service, 04 50 51 24 49).
blocks.flag: FAR fewer kitchens open on the 25th than the 24th. Book this in November alongside Christmas Eve.

days.title: Chamonix — the Mer de Glace day

blocks.title: Breakfast in the apartment
blocks.detail:
• Early: the bus is at 08:30 and Montenvers' first train is at 10:00
• Pack snacks for the bus and the glacier — Chamonix lunch is not until 13:30

blocks.title: Walk to the gare routière
blocks.detail: • Four minutes. BlaBlaCar Bus leaves from the coach station beside the railway station

blocks.title: BlaBlaCar Bus · Annecy → Chamonix Sud
blocks.detail:
• About 1h30 on the motorway and up the valley to Chamonix Sud (Avenue de Courmayeur)
• Roughly hourly; advance fares €8–15 a head, dynamic — book early for a Saturday in Christmas week
• Non-promo tickets EXCHANGE FREE up to 30 minutes before departure
• Passports not needed — this never leaves France
blocks.notes: Return included in the estimate: about €12 × 4 × 2 = €96.
blocks.flag: Book the OUTBOUND for ~08:30 and the RETURN for ~16:45–17:00 the moment December sales open (BlaBlaCar loads dates 2–3 months ahead). Last evening departures are around 17:50.

blocks.title: Walk to the Montenvers station
blocks.detail:
• About 1 km from Chamonix Sud, 13 minutes — the cogwheel station sits beside the main SNCF station
• Buy at the ticket office: the family pass and the under-5 exemption get applied there
• Allow a queue — 26 December is a peak morning

blocks.title: Montenvers Railway — the red train
blocks.detail:
• Twenty minutes of cogwheel railway through snow-covered pine to 1,913 m, opening onto the Mer de Glace
• 'Voyage Mer de Glace' family pass €148.30 covers train, gondola, ice cave and the Glaciorium for all four
• Individually: adult €49.70, child 5–14 €42.20. Under 5 free with proof of age
• Winter: first train 10:00, last descent 16:30, runs daily
blocks.notes: The single best thing in either version of this trip, and the reason this day exists.
blocks.flag: Confirm what the €148.30 family pack covers (2+2) when you book, and that the ice cave has opened — it is carved fresh each autumn.

blocks.title: Gondola down & the Grotte de Glace
blocks.detail:
• Gondola from 1,913 m to 1,760 m, then a staircase to the cave carved into the glacier
• About 170 steps down and the same back up, on open metal treads that can ice up. Hold hands; expect to carry the 5-year-old part of the way back
• No pushchairs, no lift alternative

blocks.title: Train back down
blocks.detail: • Twenty minutes. Last descent 16:30 — no pressure this early

blocks.title: Lunch — Poco Loco, Chamonix
blocks.detail:
• 47 rue du Docteur Paccard, ten minutes from the station through the pedestrian centre
• Burgers, fries, hot sandwiches, crêpes — takeaway counter, no bookings, fast; burgers about €9–14
• Open daily 10:00–22:00

blocks.title: Chamonix on foot — Mont Blanc, the Arve, the lights
blocks.detail:
• The pedestrian centre, Maison de la Montagne, the bridges over the Arve with the Aiguilles above — the Mont Blanc view you are giving up by staying in Annecy, for one afternoon
• Christmas lights and shop windows; hot chocolate at Elevation 1904 opposite the station
• Walk back towards Chamonix Sud by 16:15

blocks.title: BlaBlaCar Bus · Chamonix Sud → Annecy
blocks.detail:
• Back down the valley, about 1h30
• Home by 18:30 — a long day, and tomorrow's train is not until 12:29, so it is survivable

blocks.title: Dinner — Brasserie Saint Maurice
blocks.detail:
• 9 rue du Collège Chapuisien, old town — five minutes
• Continuous service, open late daily: no kitchen cut-off to race for after a bus
• Simple brasserie plates; reserve 04 50 51 24 49
blocks.notes: About €60–65 for four.
blocks.flag: Currently trading as 'Petit St Maurice' after a fire at the main site — confirm it is open before relying on it. Fallback: Les Burgers de Papa, two minutes from the apartment.

blocks.title: Pack
blocks.detail:
• Pack tonight, properly. Tomorrow is a four-minute walk and one direct train
• Wet gear into plastic bags
• Breakfast is in the kitchen; the travelling lunch comes from the bakery in the morning (open Sunday)

days.title: Annecy → Paris CDG — one train, no changes

blocks.title: Breakfast in the apartment
blocks.detail:
• Use up whatever is left
• Lunch is on the train at about 12:45 — buy it at the bakery first

blocks.title: Buy the travelling lunch — Pain et Copains
blocks.detail:
• 42 rue Vaugelas — five minutes, and OPEN SUNDAY 07:00–13:00 (closed Monday)
• Sandwiches and wraps about €6–7, pastries, drinks — enough for lunch on the train and something for the taxi
• Do it now, before you pack, so nobody carries suitcases to a bakery
blocks.notes: About €30 for four.

blocks.title: Finish packing
blocks.detail:
• No passports needed today — this routing never leaves France
• CONFIRM THE CHECKOUT TIME WITH THE HOST when you book; private rentals are commonly 10:00–11:00, and this morning works either way
• Strip beds or start the dishwasher only if the listing asks for it

blocks.title: Checkout
blocks.detail:
• Hand back the keys as the host instructs
• If checkout is 10:00, do this block first and the bakery run with the bags left at the station — Annecy station has luggage lockers (confirm)

blocks.title: Last look at the lake — bags with you
blocks.detail:
• Forty-five minutes of slack, deliberately: the Pâquier is ten minutes away and flat with luggage, or sit in a café by the station
• Be at the station by 11:50

blocks.title: Annecy station — board
blocks.detail:
• Four minutes from the apartment; platform posts about 20 minutes ahead
• Reserved seats — book four together, luggage-rack end if the seat map allows
• Everything anyone needs for four hours comes out of the bags now

blocks.title: TGV INOUI 6972 · Annecy → Paris Gare de Lyon
blocks.detail:
• 3h46, DIRECT — zero changes, one seat the whole way
• Runs on Sunday 27 December: confirmed on the published timetable. Fallbacks the same day: 15:29→19:14 and 17:29→21:16
• Eat the bakery lunch about 12:45; Le Bistro bar car in coach 4 or 14 for hot drinks
• Domestic TGV, so the Carte Avantage PRICE CAP applies — an adult never pays more than €89, children −60%
blocks.notes: Budgeted at $215 for four. Floor about $150 at advance fares; ceiling about $270 at the cap. Book the moment sales open on 30 September — on an EXCHANGEABLE fare, so a better option appearing in November costs nothing to switch to.
blocks.flag: Compare the Chamonix version of this day: a bus down the valley, then either a border crossing at Geneva or a slow branch line to Le Fayet, arriving Paris 17:42–18:16. This one walks to the station and is in Paris at 16:15.

blocks.title: Lunch on board — the bakery bag
blocks.detail:
• The Pain et Copains sandwiches, eaten at your seats as the train leaves the mountains
• Le Bistro bar car (coach 4 or 14) for hot drinks

blocks.title: Bar-car break
blocks.detail:
• Halfway. One adult and one child go up — it breaks the sit
• Hot chocolate about €4.50, croissant €2.70

blocks.title: Gare de Lyon — out to the car
blocks.detail:
• PRE-BOOKED car meets you on the concourse with your name on a sign (G7 app, or any Paris transfer firm) — a Sunday TGV full of returning skiers can mean a 20–30 minute rank queue
• If you queue instead: the official rank is outside the Hall 1 / Grandes Lignes exit, signposted TAXIS — marked rank only
• Loo stop before you get in

blocks.title: Taxi · Gare de Lyon → Hyatt House
blocks.detail:
• ONE CAR, STATION DOOR TO HOTEL DOOR. No changes, no shuttle, bags in the boot
• Ask for a van (monospace) so four people and the winter bags fit in one car
• Say the hotel by name: Hyatt House Paris Charles de Gaulle, rue de la Belle Étoile, Roissy-en-France
• About 28 km, 40–55 minutes on a Sunday afternoon. Roughly €60–75 on the meter; €10–15 more pre-booked
blocks.notes: The regulated €56 flat fare covers Paris ⇄ the AIRPORT only; the hotel sits five minutes past it, so this runs on the meter. Budgeted at €75 pre-booked.
blocks.flag: Cheaper: RER D → Gare du Nord, RER B → CDG, then the hotel shuttle — €42 in fares plus €8 in Navigo Easy cards, about 60 minutes. Worth €16 only if everyone is fresh.

blocks.title: Check in — Hyatt House Paris Charles de Gaulle
blocks.detail:
• Kitchenette-equipped suites, free airport shuttle, about fifteen minutes from the terminals
• CONFIRM the first shuttle departure tomorrow — you need to be at CDG by about 06:40
• Buy tomorrow's early breakfast at the hotel H Market (open 24/7) TONIGHT, before bed
blocks.notes: 15,000 points for the night as given. The $12 is Roissy-en-France tourist tax for two adults, payable at checkout.
blocks.flag: Confirm whether 15,000 covers one room or two. The Paris stay uses two rooms; if this night needs two as well, it is 30,000. Alternative that removes the shuttle entirely: the Sheraton INSIDE Terminal 2, about €195 a room — see the Ideas tab.

blocks.title: Dinner — ZOOM, in the hotel
blocks.detail:
• Eat in the hotel: ZOOM serves dinner 18:00–22:00, children's menu €15
• Arriving at 17:30 instead of 19:30 is the whole point of the Annecy routing — dinner at six, kids down by eight, a real night's sleep before a 05:30 start
blocks.notes: About €70–80 for four. If ZOOM is full or closed: Hippopotamus, 309 rue de la Belle Étoile, 5 minutes on foot, open Sunday to 23:00, children's menu €7.50 — reserve on 01 48 63 18 97.
blocks.flag: Brasserie Le Village in Roissy village is CLOSED at weekends — not an option on a Sunday.

blocks.title: Wake & quick breakfast
blocks.detail:
• Whatever you bought last night, eaten in the room — the hotel breakfast service may not have started
• A proper breakfast is served on board about an hour after take-off

blocks.title: Shuttle to CDG Terminal 2E
blocks.detail:
• Free hotel shuttle, about fifteen minutes
• Confirm the first run at check-in the night before — if it starts later than 06:15, book a taxi instead
blocks.flag: Verify the shuttle's first departure. An airport shuttle that starts at 07:00 does not work for a 9:10 flight.

blocks.title: CDG — check in, security, passport control
blocks.detail:
• Delta departs Terminal 2E
• Schengen EXIT control plus US-bound security screening — allow the full window
• Two and a half hours is right for a transatlantic with four people and checked bags

blocks.title: Delta 83 · CDG → Atlanta
blocks.detail:
• About 10h15 in the air (Paris is UTC+1, Atlanta UTC−5)
• BEST-FED FLIGHT OF THE TRIP. Complimentary meals and complimentary beer/wine/spirits for over-21s — Delta does this on international flights over 6h30
• First service is LUNCH, not breakfast: appetizer, hot entrée, dessert, about an hour after take-off (~10:00–10:15 Paris time)
• Second lighter hot service about 1h–1h30 before landing
• CHILD MEALS: order in My Trips or the Fly Delta app, at least 24h ahead. The lunch version is cheese tortellini with marinara, carrots and broccoli with ranch, fruit, graham cookies — and it is SERVED FIRST, before the main cabin
• Do not over-eat at CDG; lunch comes early
blocks.notes: 60,000 SkyMiles + €117 per person. Four passengers = 240,000 SkyMiles + €468 (about $543). Fare class NL, 9 seats showing. Total elapsed CDG→MIA is 16h05.
blocks.flag: More than double the outbound award — 240,000 SkyMiles against 110,000 on Aer Lingus. The same Delta metal may be bookable through Virgin Atlantic or Air France/KLM Flying Blue for materially fewer points. Price both before spending 240K.

blocks.title: Atlanta — 3h47 layover
blocks.detail:
• US immigration and customs happen HERE, not Miami — first port of entry
• Recheck bags after customs, then back through security to the domestic concourse
• The long layover is doing real work: it absorbs the immigration queue without risking the Miami leg
• Proper sit-down meal here — it is the last one of the trip and everyone will need it

blocks.title: Late lunch at ATL
blocks.detail:
• EAT PROPERLY HERE — this is the one meal today that is not on a plane, and the Miami leg has only a packaged snack with nothing for sale
• After customs and re-clearing security, on the domestic concourse
• Two tired children at the end of a transatlantic day with a bag of pretzels is the one avoidable failure point in this itinerary
• Plenty of choice on Concourse B/T; buy extra to carry on

blocks.title: Delta 1328 · Atlanta → Miami
blocks.detail:
• Home, arriving 7:15 PM
• SNACK ONLY, and nothing can be bought: Delta's buy-on-board menu only runs on flights over 900 miles, and ATL–MIA is about 595
• You do get a free snack choice and a Starbucks coffee or soft drink — that is all
• This is why the Atlanta meal matters: the flight leaves at dinnertime and lands at 7:15 PM

ideas.title: 🗺️ WHY ANNECY — what this version changes, and what it costs you
ideas.detail:
This is the same trip with the six mountain nights moved from Chamonix to Annecy. Paris (17–21), the CDG night (27) and every flight are unchanged.

WHAT YOU GAIN
• ONE DIRECT TRAIN each way. Paris → Annecy 09:46→13:29 on the 21st; Annecy → Paris 12:29→16:15 on the 27th. No Geneva, no border, no coach, no Le Fayet branch line. Both are domestic TGV INOUI, so the Carte Avantage €89 cap applies both ways.
• The 27th ends at the airport hotel at 17:30 instead of 19:30 — dinner at six, kids down by eight, before a 05:30 wake-up.
• Christmas in a proper town: the Noël des Alpes market, an outdoor rink in the gardens, a château, the lake — all on foot from the door.
• Lodging about $380 cheaper than Cham sud, in a bigger apartment with a full kitchen and a washing machine.
• The snow is cheaper: Semnoz is a €2 city bus with FREE sledging and FREE conveyor lifts.

WHAT YOU GIVE UP
• Waking up in the mountains. Annecy sits at 450 m; snow in town at Christmas is rare. The snow is a bus ride away — about an hour each time.
• Planpraz, Argentière, the Mont-Blanc Express, lunch in Italy through the tunnel. The Mer de Glace survives as a day trip on the 26th.
• Mont Blanc from the window. You see it once, on the Chamonix day.

THE BUS HONESTY: every snow outing from Annecy is 60–70 minutes by bus — Semnoz 60, Le Grand-Bornand 70, Chamonix 90. The plan alternates snow days with town days so it is never two long buses in a row, and a taxi to Semnoz (about 25 minutes, €35–55) is the escape hatch.

ideas.title: 🏨 LODGING — La Madeleine, and the two alternatives
ideas.detail:
CHOSEN — LA MADELEINE, 7 rue de l'Annexion. One-bedroom apartment, 431 ft², full kitchen with dishwasher, washing machine, balcony, elevator. Four minutes from the station, five from the old town. Booking 7.9/10 (162 reviews). Free-cancellation rate $859 for six nights before 10% VAT and a 5% 'city tax' line — budgeted $990 all in. Non-refundable $773. Cancel free until 16 December.

CHEAPER — SÉJOURS & AFFAIRES ANNECY LE PONT NEUF, 8 rue du Rond Point, Cran-Gevrier. Chain aparthotel, 377 ft² apartment with kitchen and balcony, Booking 7.5 (1,388 reviews). $624 refundable before VAT and €1/person/night tax — about $700 all in, so $290 less than La Madeleine. The catch: 15 minutes' walk to the station and 20 to the old town, both of which you would do twice a day in December. One real advantage: the Semnoz bus stops at 'Pont Neuf', on its doorstep.

BRAND SAFETY — APARTHOTEL ADAGIO ANNECY CENTRE, beside the station. Studio for four with kitchenette, Booking 8.3 (2,776 reviews), pay at the property, free cancellation. About $219 a night — $1,314 for the week, so no saving over Chamonix.

NOT CHOSEN: Au Faubourg (old town, 8.4, $961) is a 248 ft² studio — too small for four for six nights. The 9.5-rated 'Appartement de charme au cœur de la vieille ville' is $1,187.

Every Annecy apartment on Booking that sleeps four is one bedroom plus a sofa bed — same as Cham sud. Two-bedroom places start about $1,180.

ideas.title: 🚄 TRAINS — book on 30 September, exchangeable fares
ideas.detail:
SNCF opens sales for 13 Dec 2026 – 6 Jan 2027 on Wednesday 30 September 2026, about 05:45. Both legs are domestic TGV INOUI — buy ONE Carte Avantage Adulte (€49) first: −30% for the holder and one companion adult, −60% for both children 4–11, and a hard cap of €89 per adult on any domestic TGV.

OUT — Monday 21 December, Paris Gare de Lyon → Annecy, direct. Published: 06:45→10:38, 09:46→13:29 (the plan), 12:46→16:34, 17:46, 18:46.

BACK — Sunday 27 December, TGV INOUI 6972, Annecy → Paris Gare de Lyon 12:29→16:15, direct. Also that day: 08:18→12:15, 15:29→19:14, 17:29→21:16.

Buy EXCHANGEABLE fares on both. Regional timetables and seasonal extras firm up in November; an exchangeable ticket means a better option costs nothing to move to.

Budgeted $215 each way for four — floor about $150 at opening-day fares, ceiling about $270 at the cap.

ideas.title: 🛷 THE SNOW — where, how much, and the one risk
ideas.detail:
LE SEMNOZ (22nd, 25th) — 1,700 m, directly above the lake. FREE toboggan piste with nets and TWO FREE CONVEYOR LIFTS; sledge hire €5 half-day / €8 day at the Nordic Forest chalet; 60 m snow-tubing track from age 3 on a points card (from about €4). Restaurant at the top: Le 1407. Bus S1/S2 from Annecy Gare, about 60 minutes, standard €2 SIBRA fare, DAILY 20 Dec–4 Jan; departures 07:30, 08:30, 09:30, 10:30, 12:00, 13:15; returns 10:40, 11:45, 14:25, 15:45, 16:45, 17:45, 18:15 (2025–26 sheet). REDUCED service on 24 December confirmed for 2025. THE RISK: Semnoz has closed entirely in low-snow Decembers — check semnoz.fr the night before, and swap the Grand-Bornand day forward if it is shut.

LE GRAND-BORNAND (24th) — 1,000 m village, 1,300 m+ at Chinaillon and the top of Rosay. Two FREE sledging areas in the village (La Grenouille at Borne, L'Abeille at Venay) — the 5-year-old needs no lift. Rosay gondola pedestrian ticket €7.70 return per person aged 5+, under-5 free; snow-tubing track at the top (from age 3, price not published); 'La Marmotte' 2,600 m² sledging area at the summit. Bus Y62/Y63 from the gare routière, 1h10, €8.60 single / €16 return adult, child fare not published. Lunch: Pizzeria Casanova, menu enfant €10.

LA CLUSAZ (swap-in) — same bus, one hour. Three free sledging slopes; outdoor rink €6.50 adult / €5 child 5–16, skates €4–5; Pizza Minut has a children's pizza.

CHAMONIX (26th) — BlaBlaCar Bus from the gare routière, about 1h30, €8–15 a head, exchangeable; Montenvers family pass €148.30; first train 10:00, last descent 16:30.

SNOW REALITY: at village level (Annecy 450 m, Grand-Bornand 1,000 m) Christmas snow is a coin flip. Everything in this plan happens at 1,300–1,900 m, where it is not.

ideas.title: 💰 BUDGET — what Annecy does to the number
ideas.detail:
Same Paris, same flights, same CDG night. The Annecy week replaces the Chamonix week roughly like this:

CHEAPER
• Lodging: La Madeleine $990 vs Cham sud $1,370 — about −$380.
• Snow: two Semnoz days on a €2 bus with free sledging and free lifts, against Planpraz (€77.60) and Les Planards (€47.50). About −$120.
• Transport out: one domestic TGV ($215) instead of Lyria + Geneva coach ($267). About −$50.
• Courmayeur is gone (−$266 in bus, park and Italian lunch), replaced by Le Grand-Bornand at about $145 — net about −$120.

DEARER OR THE SAME
• The Chamonix day trip adds the BlaBlaCar return (about $100) to a Montenvers day you were doing anyway.
• Christmas Eve is budgeted the same ($250). Christmas Day is CHEAPER ($110 vs $186) because the festive meal is lunch on the mountain.

The build's own total is printed in the Money tab. Expect it to land roughly $600–700 under the Chamonix version, and within reach of the $5,000 cap for the first time — the Séjours & Affaires apartment (−$290) would get it there.

ideas.title: ⚠ TRIP-BREAKER — Leavenworth collision
ideas.detail: This trip is Dec 16–28, 2026. Leavenworth Winter 2026 is Dec 19–27, 2026 with MIA→SEA booked on Dec 19 (Alaska AS305, conf UUKHNQ) and a Hampton Inn on 308K Hilton points. They overlap by eight days and both depart from Miami. These cannot both happen. Nothing here should be booked until one of them moves.

ideas.title: 🛏️ THE LAST NIGHT — Hyatt House vs the Sheraton inside Terminal 2
ideas.detail:
The plan keeps the Hyatt House (15,000 points, free shuttle, 05:30 wake-up for a 06:15 shuttle). With the Annecy routing you are there by 17:30, so the early night is comfortable and the points stay the better deal.

If you would rather remove the shuttle altogether: the Sheraton Paris Airport is BUILT INTO TERMINAL 2 with indoor access to the Delta check-in — walk downstairs at 06:30. About €195 a room, and the hotel will not take four in one room, so two rooms: roughly $425 cash for the night. The regulated €56 taxi flat fare from Gare de Lyon applies to it, since it is at the airport itself.
